item.text:
The product currently refunds **5.69**, but its documented behavior requires **5.70**.

The [refund rule](/Users/yousefallaban/MyProjects/scrubjay-example/docs/behavior/returns/submit-return.md:10) says “rounded half up to the cent” and explicitly gives this exact example: an 8.50 trail map with 33% off → 5.70.

The [implementation](/Users/yousefallaban/MyProjects/scrubjay-example/src/returns.ts:24) uses floating-point arithmetic. I reproduced its calculation: it produces `569.4999999999999` cents, which rounds down to 569 cents instead of up to 570.

This is a rounding bug that under-refunds the customer by **0.01**. No fix spec exists yet; I can start one.
